notes.title: Plastiland Update and Trading Cards News.
notes.content:
Howdy!

We have two good news to share:

1. We worked hard and fixed the nasty bug with the Alt+F4 and staying in the game after closing it. In case you have some other problems, please contact us it in this discussion: http://steamcommunity.com/app/421880/discussions/0/492379439667615751/
2. Trading Cards are finally here! There are 8 cards, cute badges with planets and plastiball's smiles. We hope you enjoy it! 

[img=http://i.imgur.com/rXe5h2x.png]
